body:
Animal Hospital of Milton is a downtown veterinary hospital that has been providing comprehensive care for dogs and cats since 2004. The clinic offers preventive wellness exams, vaccinations, diagnostics, surgery, dental care, and support for pets with chronic health concerns. Serving clients from Milton and across the GTA, the team focuses on practical, individualized treatment plans and strives to make visits as comfortable as possible for both pets and their owners. Animal Hospital of Milton also provides client education and follow-up guidance to help families manage their pets’ health at home between visits.

body:
Credit Valley Animal Hospital is part of the VCA Canada network and provides full-service veterinary care for dogs and cats in east Mississauga. Located on Satellite Drive, the hospital offers wellness and vaccination programs, internal medicine, surgery, diagnostics, dentistry, and pharmacy services under one roof. With extended weekday and weekend hours, the clinic is designed to make veterinary care more accessible for busy pet owners. As a VCA hospital, Credit Valley Animal Hospital also connects clients with additional resources, including tele-triage support and access to a wider network of veterinary expertise.

description: Hollybank Animal Hospital in south Milton offers veterinary care, surgery, dentistry, and wellness services for dogs, cats, and small companion animals.
body:
Hollybank Animal Hospital is a companion animal practice serving the growing neighbourhoods in south Milton. The clinic provides preventive care, vaccinations, diagnostics, surgery, dentistry, and nutritional counselling for dogs, cats, and small exotic pets such as rabbits and guinea pigs. With a focus on client education and long-term relationships, the team works with families to design care plans that fit each pet’s needs and lifestyle. Hollybank Animal Hospital operates alongside its sister clinic in Mississauga to give pet owners flexible options for appointments and follow-up care.

The hospital offers preventive health care, medical and surgical services, dental care, diagnostics, and nutritional counselling for dogs and cats. Its veterinary team emphasizes continuity of care, aiming to build long-term relationships with clients and to follow pets through every life stage.
